findings.passage: "That amounts to a poll tax for many people, in my view," said Frankel. "In other words, you're going to have to pay something in order to get the right to vote. That's not constitutional. So my bill would reimburse everybody up to $50 for the cost of obtaining their birth certificates."
findings.note: Quoted by 90.5 WESA in 2012, about the then-new state photo ID law: birth certificate fees as a cost of getting an ID, and his bill to reimburse up to $50.
